# SnapCalorie

> > SnapCalorie is an AI-powered calorie tracking app that uses computer vision to recognize food from photos and provide instant nutritional analysis.

SnapCalorie combines advanced computer vision technology with a comprehensive nutrition database to simplify dietary tracking. The platform offers mobile apps for iOS and Android, featuring AI-driven food recognition, meal planning, healthy recipes, and evidence-based nutrition education.

## Key Topics

- AI calorie tracking
- Computer vision food recognition
- Nutrition database
- Mobile app (iOS/Android)
- Meal planning
- Food logging
- Nutritional information
- Diet tracking
- Healthy recipes
- Portion sizing
- Keto diet
- Mediterranean diet
- Vegan nutrition
- Health tracking
- CVPR 2021
